dessin: A geographic feature record sheet: one square flat pale sheet #FBFCF8 with a 2 px ink outline and a second thin ink outline offset just outside it (a double frame). At the top, a header band about 11% of the sheet height, closed below by one horizontal ink line across the full width; the header band is completely empty, plain pale. In the body below the header, centered, one single irregular closed outline drawn with a thick crisp ink #23281F line: a polygon with seven straight sides of different lengths and sharp corners, like the boundary of a field seen from above on a map; it is not a rectangle, not a house, not a building, and it has no hatching and no fill other than the pale paper. The outline spans about half of the sheet width and about half of the body height. Everything else in the body is empty pale paper: no section lines, no bars, no globe, no symbols, no text. Nothing outside the sheet.
